title: Geometric parameter sequences for $Q$-polynomial distance-regular graphs
summary: Let $Γ$ be a distance-regular graph with diameter $D \geq 3$, and let $θ$ be a nonzero eigenvalue of $Γ$ distinct from its valency. Motivated by the geometric parameter sequences of geometric distance-regular graphs, we introduce analogous sequences defined recursively from the intersection numbers of $Γ$ and $θ$, without assuming a geometric structure. We show that the recursion is well defined if and only if all terms of the standard sequence corresponding to $θ$ are nonzero and consecutive terms are distinct.
